_comment: The last EAS build that actually shipped this app, recorded so CI can
tell when mobile/ has drifted ahead of what anyone can install.
This exists because on 2026-08-21 the installed app turned out to be
three days and eleven commits stale. The share button the owner was
looking for had never been in a build. Nothing surfaced that: CI
typechecks mobile/ but has never built it, and the API deploys on every
merge, so the two halves drifted apart silently.
Update it by running `node scripts/record-eas-build.mjs` from mobile/
AFTER a build finishes. It reads the real build from EAS rather than
